_comment: Manifest for the factory's GitHub App. Phase 6 of setup POSTs this to
GitHub, the user clicks Create, and the script converts the returned code
into the app id, client id and private key.
`workflows` is absent on purpose, not set to none: a permission that is
not requested cannot be granted. That is what stops the factory editing
.github/workflows and so tampering with the gates that judge it.
name: Build Software Factory
description: Runs the software factory on this repository: opens draft PRs, reports gate results, and labels and comments on issues. Cannot edit workflows.
